sn15.2:1.3: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.2:1.4: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso imaṃ mahāpaṭhaviṃ kolaṭṭhikamattaṃ kolaṭṭhikamattaṃ guḷikaṃ karitvā nikkhipeyya,
sn15.2:1.5: ayaṃ me pitā, tassa me pitu ayaṃ pitāti. apariyādinnāva kho bhikkhave tassa purisassa pitu pitaro assu. athāyaṃ mahāpaṭhavī parikkhayaṃ pariyādinnaṃ gaccheyya.
sn15.2:1.8: pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
sn15.2:1.9: evaṃ dīgharattaṃ vo bhikkhave, dukkhaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, tibbaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, vyasanaṃ paccanubhūtaṃ, kaṭasi vaḍḍhitā.
sn15.2:1.10: yāvañcidaṃ bhikkhave, alameva sabbasaṅkhāresu nibbindituṃ, alaṃ virajjituṃ, alaṃ vimuccitunti.
